3-porch-farm.sourceNote: Farm's own homepage (3porchfarm.com, fetched 2026-11-17): Mandy and Steve, Comer GA, farm store, carbon-neutral shipping; heirloom-mum specialty per FLORET-SEED-SOURCES.md workup.
3-porch-farm.summary: 3 Porch Farm is Mandy and Steve O'Shea's flower farm in Comer, Georgia. The farm sells through its own farm store and online, runs on a strong sustainability footing — including carbon-neutral shipping — and is known for its heirloom chrysanthemums.

_note: Profile summaries for /seller pages, written 2026-11-16 in our own words from each farm's own website (homepages/About fetched 2026-11-17 UTC) plus the exemplar dossiers (SELLER-SEED-LIST.md, EXEMPLAR-TERMS-REVIEW-2026-11-16.md). No text copied verbatim; no facts beyond what each source states. Applied to catalog.json seller.description by the seller-batch build.

american-meadows.sourceNote: Company's own homepage (americanmeadows.com, fetched 2026-11-17) + catalog location (Champlain Valley, VT).
american-meadows.summary: American Meadows is a Vermont wildflower-seed specialist, built around helping gardeners plant meadows rather than lawns. Its range centres on wildflower seed and region-matched mixes for different parts of the country, alongside bulbs and perennial plants.

blomma-flower-farm.summary: Blomma Flower Farm is Tiffany and Mike Jones's small family farm in Gardnerville, Nevada, breeding new cut-flower zinnias. Tiffany selects for long stems and the muted colours florists and designers ask for — work she has written up in The Zinnia Breeder's Handbook — and the farm sells its seed in an annual seed sale.

botanical-interests.sourceNote: Company's own homepage (botanicalinterests.com, fetched 2026-11-17): Broomfield CO address, ranges, guides. Packet-content detail is the company's long-standing stated format.
botanical-interests.summary: Botanical Interests is a Broomfield, Colorado seed company selling flower, vegetable and herb seed packets, known for the growing guidance packed into its packets and its extensive gardening guides. It sells to home gardeners online and through garden centres, with a wholesale arm for retailers.

dawn-creek-farm.summary: Dawn Creek Farm is Kori Hargreaves' farm in California's Santa Cruz Mountains, where she has bred zinnias since 2016. She sells seed of her own breeding once a year through a fundraiser sale window — limited to one packet per person — with breeder attribution terms attached to her lines.

floret.summary: Floret is Erin Benzakein's Skagit Valley, Washington flower farm and breeding programme, known worldwide for the Floret Originals seed lines — bred zinnias, dahlias and sweet peas among them. Floret sells its own seed only occasionally, in episodic sale windows, rather than through a standing shop.

great-basin-seed.sourceNote: Company's own homepage (greatbasinseeds.com, fetched 2026-11-17): 'since 1974', ranges, Utah certification note.
great-basin-seed.summary: Great Basin Seed, in Ephraim, Utah, has worked with farmers and ranchers since 1974. It specialises in seed for farm, ranch and range — pasture and turf grasses, cover crops, reclamation and post-fire recovery seed, and regional wildflower mixes for the Intermountain West and beyond.

half-moons-farm.summary: Half Moon's Farm is a small flower farm in Ferndale, Washington, established in 2022. Alongside seasonal flowers — a roadside stand, subscriptions and wholesale stems — the farm sells its own sweet pea seed in packets through its online shop, mostly across the fall and winter.

high-mowing-organic-seeds.summary: High Mowing Organic Seeds, in Wolcott, Vermont, sells 100% certified organic, non-GMO seed for growers and gardeners. New varieties are evaluated on the company's own Vermont trials farm, and every lot is tested for germination, disease and GMO contamination.

hudson-valley-seed-co.summary: Hudson Valley Seed Co., based in Accord, New York, grows much of its seed on its own farm and with regional growers, and commissions artists to design its Art Pack packets. Much of the line is certified organic, and the range spans flowers, vegetables and herbs sold through a standing online shop.

jig-bee-flower-farm.summary: Jig-Bee Flower Farm, in Corinth, Vermont, has grown open-pollinated, sustainably raised seed since 2015, specialising in varieties that thrive in cool climates. The farm breeds its own lines — including Scabiosa 'Misty Mountain' and 'Lavender Picotee' and Strawflower 'Berry Bowl' — and sells seed year-round.

johnnys-selected-seeds.sourceNote: Company's own materials (johnnyseeds.com About PDF + site, verified 2026-11-16): employee-owned, Winslow ME HQ, Albion research farm, breeding scale.
johnnys-selected-seeds.summary: Johnny's Selected Seeds is an employee-owned seed company in Winslow, Maine, serving growers and gardeners since 1973. Johnny's breeds and trials many of its own varieties at its Albion, Maine research farm — tens of thousands of breeding-nursery plants a year — across vegetables, flowers and herbs.

millay-and-meadowlark-flower-farm.summary: Millay & Meadowlark is a flower farm outside Missoula, Montana, growing seasonal flowers for weddings and events. The farm also curates specialty sweet pea seed — chosen for fragrance and long stems, from the same varieties it grows and designs with — and sells packets through its online shop.

peace-seedlings.summary: Peace Seedlings is Dylana Kapuler and Mario DiBenedetto's seed project in Corvallis, Oregon, started in 2008 as a continuation of Peace Seeds — the pioneering organic seed work of Dylana's parents, Alan and Linda Kapuler. Everything is small-batch, organic and open-pollinated, grown, cleaned and packed by the two of them on the same three acres farmed since the early 1990s; orders are still taken by mail and email, paid by check.

prairie-moon-nursery.sourceNote: Nursery's own homepage (prairiemoon.com, fetched 2026-11-17): 'over 700 species', natives for gardening and restoration.
prairie-moon-nursery.summary: Prairie Moon Nursery, near Winona, Minnesota, is a native-plant specialist carrying seed and plants of more than 700 North American species. It supplies both home gardeners and ecological restoration projects, with a catalogue organised around sun, shade and pollinator plantings.

renees-garden.sourceNote: Company's own homepage (reneesgarden.com, fetched 2026-11-17): 'A Note from Renee', since 1985, trial policy.
renees-garden.summary: Renee's Garden is Renee Shepherd's California seed company, offering heirloom and organic vegetable, herb and flower seed sourced from around the world since 1985. Renee trials everything herself — tasting the vegetables and cutting the flowers — and sells nothing she hasn't grown in her own trial gardens.

seed-savers-exchange.sourceNote: Organisation's own homepage (seedsavers.org, fetched 2026-11-17): founded 1975, mission, Heritage Farm, Decorah IA.
seed-savers-exchange.summary: Seed Savers Exchange is the Decorah, Iowa nonprofit founded in 1975 to keep heirloom seed in gardens and on tables. From its Heritage Farm it collects, regenerates and shares endangered garden and food-crop varieties, selling heirloom seed and connecting a nationwide community of seed savers.

select-seeds.sourceNote: Company's own homepage (selectseeds.com, fetched 2026-11-17): since 1987, second-generation, hand-packed seed, sustainability.
select-seeds.summary: Select Seeds is a second-generation family business in Union, Connecticut, growing family, farm and flowers since 1987. It specialises in heirloom and old-fashioned flower seed and plants — seeds packed by hand — with a strong sustainability programme across its greenhouses and shipping.

songbird-seed-co.sourceNote: SELLER-SEED-LIST.md exemplar dossier (farm's own site + Hues' buying history).
songbird-seed-co.summary: Songbird Seed Co. is Colleen Raney's Skagit Valley, Washington seed company, specialising in sweet peas. A former landscape designer, Colleen grows and trials British sweet pea varieties on the farm and sells farm-grown packets through her online shop — a specialist list that runs to hundreds of varieties.

summertime-seed-co.summary: Summertime Seed Co. is a family farm in Oregon's Willamette Valley that has produced certified organic flower, vegetable and herb seed for wholesale since 2010, and now sells direct as well. All of its seed is open-pollinated, and every lot is germination-tested at an accredited third-party lab before sale.

sunflower-selections.sourceNote: FLORET-SEED-SOURCES.md workup + breeder background verified by web search 2026-11-16 (NuFlowers/Dr. Tom Heaton, Woodland CA).
sunflower-selections.summary: Sunflower Selections is the retail seed site of NuFlowers LLC in Woodland, California — the breeding programme of Dr. Tom Heaton. It sells seed of his own sunflower breeding, including the ProCut and Starburst lines developed for cut-flower growers.

sunflower-steve-seed-co.summary: Sunflower Steve Seed Co. is Wisconsin sunflower breeder Steve Kaufer's seed company. Steve has bred sunflowers since about 2008 and sells seed of his own varieties — including the Van Gogh's Fantasy line — through his online shop, with seed sold in episodic drops.

the-gardeners-workshop.sourceNote: Business's own homepage (thegardenersworkshop.com, verified 2026-11-16): family-run, Newport News VA 23608, seeds/tools/courses.
the-gardeners-workshop.summary: The Gardener's Workshop is Lisa Mason Ziegler's family-run business in Newport News, Virginia, built on her years as a commercial cut-flower grower. The shop sells flower seed — including her well-known cool-season collections — alongside the tools and supplies she uses on the farm, plus expert-led courses for growers and gardeners.

three-brothers-blooms.sourceNote: Farm's own seed packet + FLORET-SEED-SOURCES.md workup (Camano Island WA verified 2026-11-16).
three-brothers-blooms.summary: Three Brothers Blooms is Brenna Estrada's flower farm on Camano Island, Washington. The farm specialises in pansy and viola seed — including seed from the Faraone Mennella hybridisers in Italy — and Brenna is the author of Pansies, a Timber Press guide to growing them.

wild-west-seed.summary: Wild West Seed is an Albany, Oregon seed producer in the Willamette Valley, working with local partner growers. It is a wholesale and bulk operation — wildflower mixes including regional and custom blends, plus contract seed production — rather than a packet shop for home gardeners.
